blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cyprus, Slovakia and Slovenia formally joined the Association of Southeast Asian Nations’ (Asean) Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on Saturday ahead of the regional bloc’s summit in Manila.
